**UI-for-ytdlp v0.3.5** adds download quality presets in Settings.

#### Quality
- Settings: **480p**, **720p**, **1080p**, or **maximum available** (default, same as before)
- Stored as `VIDEO_QUALITY` in `config.json`; applies on the next download
- Plugin format hints (e.g. GoodGame VOD) still override `-f`

#### Settings window
- Dialog size is clamped to the screen after DPI scaling so it stays usable on smaller displays
